resources.string: Enter what you can do – e.g. a pull-up with +20 kg for 5 reps, or a 32 kg pick-up on 20 mm for 10 s with the right hand – or run a short test. CruxCoach turns it into today\'s loads: loaded reps with two in reserve, max hangs at about 90 %, repeaters at about 65 % of your 10-second maximum, bodyweight reps and holds at about 70 % of your maximum. When a logged set shows you are stronger, the value rises by itself and the next session plans more. Your first session with an exercise also sets a starting value.
What can you do? Enter it or test it – CruxCoach plans your loads from these values and raises them when your logs show progress.
Log your body weight first: added-weight values and % body weight need it.
Every exercise with load, reps or a hold has this card on its detail page.
The heaviest set you can do cleanly: load and reps (1–30). From that CruxCoach estimates your one-rep max.
The most you can hold: load, hold time and edge. 10 s is the reference; other times are converted.
Your maximum number of clean reps in one set.
